_notes.format: Each job describes a reference motion-preview animation for use during asset generation and in-game choreography planning. out_dir receives frame PNGs + a manifest.json.

jobs.name: sparkle-tier0-idle
jobs.prompt: Sparkle idle animation in BlueNoMid Base outfit: subtle body bob up and down with floating head drifting slightly, detached hands resting at sides, feet hovering just below the torso, minimal lateral sway, slow 2-second loop

jobs.name: sparkle-tier1-sash-pulse
jobs.prompt: Sparkle dancing with Pulse Sash: sash stripe flares in time with a kick beat, left hand snapping upward on Head Flick beats, torso twisting on Torso Pulse beats, 2-second loop at 142 BPM

jobs.name: sparkle-tier2-skirt-spin
jobs.prompt: Sparkle spinning with Prism Skirt fanning out in a visible-spectrum petal spread, each skirt panel a distinct spectral colour, detached hands arcing wide during spin, feet kicked outward, 1-second spin loop

jobs.name: sparkle-tier3-halo-rig-cable-flow
jobs.prompt: Sparkle with Halo Rig: shoulder-cables flowing dynamically with hand motion, halo ring slightly tilting back and forth above the head, hands extending laterally trailing ribbon cables, ribbon tips snap on beat hits, 2-second combat loop

jobs.name: sparkle-tier4-light-envisioned-transform
jobs.prompt: Sparkle transforming into Light Envisioned form: crown-halo erupts upward from the head, five spectral ribbon-blades fan outward from the torso in sequence, radiance crescendos brighter each frame until fully bloomed, one-shot 48-frame sequence

jobs.name: sparkle-poselock-hold
jobs.prompt: Sparkle locked in pose-hold anticipation: target ring orbits around the torso, body frozen at a fixed silhouette angle with slight trembling vibration, finisher bloom glow building outward from the torso, 1-second hold loop

jobs.name: sparkle-poselock-success
jobs.prompt: Sparkle pose-lock success obliteration: body flash-expands to full radiance, spectral collapse burst explodes outward in a ring, ribbon streaks shoot off in five directions, then Sparkle snaps back to idle glowing brightly, one-shot 36-frame sequence

jobs.name: sparkle-poselock-fail
jobs.prompt: Sparkle recoils from a failed pose-lock: body snaps backward, cold-blue light drains away, hands recoil inward, a harsh backward streak flashes through the silhouette, settles back into idle in 24 frames

jobs.name: litemite-archetype0-prism-bloom-idle
jobs.prompt: Prism Bloom LiteMite idle: six-point rainbow burst slowly rotating, tail drifting leftward in a lazy sine wave, swarm motes circling in two-orbit rings, golden warm glow pulsing softly, 3-second loop

jobs.name: litemite-archetype0-prism-bloom-telegraph
jobs.prompt: Prism Bloom telegraphing a lane: one burst tip brightens dramatically and fires a spectral beam toward a lane marker at the bottom of the field, then dims back, 0.5-second sequence on repeat

jobs.name: litemite-archetype1-glue-braid-idle
jobs.prompt: Glue Braid LiteMite idle: three viscous amber blobs slowly oozing and re-merging, ribbon weft threads between them stretching and snapping back, tail draped in a reverse S-curve swaying almost imperceptibly, 4-second loop

jobs.name: litemite-archetype1-glue-braid-snare-snap
jobs.prompt: Glue Braid reacts to a snare hit: the three blobs slam together in a single blob then rebounce apart, sending a sticky shock ring outward before resuming drift, 0.5-second impulse

jobs.name: litemite-archetype2-ember-choir-orbit
jobs.prompt: Ember Choir LiteMite: three molten amber-pink petals orbiting a pale-violet center in a trefoil pattern, each trailing visible-spectrum ember dust wisps, center pulsing with a slow heartbeat glow, 2-second orbit loop

jobs.name: litemite-archetype2-ember-choir-scatter
jobs.prompt: Ember Choir scatters: three petals fly outward in a triangle, each sprays a fan of ember motes, then they curve and snap back to orbit in 1 second, combat telegraph animation

jobs.name: litemite-archetype3-halo-scythe-sweep
jobs.prompt: Halo Scythe LiteMite: the offset halo sweeps a full arc around the main ring like a clock hand moving counterclockwise, inner burst flares on the sweep endpoint, crimson slash tail follows the arc, 1-second loop

jobs.name: litemite-archetype3-halo-scythe-lock-warning
jobs.prompt: Halo Scythe near defeat warning: entire form brightens to full silver-blue, outer ring pulses rapidly three times, then a pause — warning that pose-lock is now possible, 1-second sequence

jobs.name: litemite-archetype4-luster-knot-idle
jobs.prompt: Luster Knot LiteMite idle: three deep-violet spheres slowly breathing in and out, five satellite motes orbiting in a loose pentagon, five-pointed golden outer burst blades slowly rotating counterclockwise, tail knotted in a figure-8 undulation, 3-second loop

jobs.name: litemite-archetype4-luster-knot-final-phase
jobs.prompt: Luster Knot entering final phase: all three spheres crack open revealing a golden core, satellite motes accelerate their orbit, burst blades lock into an aggressive spread and stop rotating — imposing and dangerous, 1.5-second one-shot

jobs.name: litemite-defeat-universal
jobs.prompt: Universal LiteMite defeat: the enemy form flashes white, then a warm ring expands rapidly outward carrying spectral debris, leaving only dark void with floating ember motes that slowly fade to nothing, one-shot 36-frame sequence
